description: Implementation of WorkerThread and related thread pool classes for ANGLE, including single-threaded and asynchronous thread pools, with conditional compilation based on ANGLE_STD_ASYNC_WORKERS.

classes.name: WaitableEvent
classes.description: Base class representing an event that can be waited on.

classes.name: WaitableEventDone
classes.description: A trivial implementation of WaitableEvent indicating completion.

classes.name: WorkerThreadPool
classes.description: Abstract base class for thread pools managing worker tasks.

classes.name: SingleThreadedWorkerPool
classes.description: Thread pool implementation for single-threaded execution.

classes.name: AsyncWaitableEvent
classes.description: WaitableEvent implementation for asynchronous execution, using futures and condition variables.

classes.name: AsyncWorkerPool
classes.description: Thread pool implementation for multi-threaded asynchronous execution.

methods.name: WaitableEvent::wait
methods.description: Method to wait for the event to be signaled.

methods.name: WaitableEventDone::isReady
methods.description: Always returns true, indicating event is ready.

methods.name: SingleThreadedWorkerPool::postWorkerTask
methods.description: Executes the task immediately and returns a completed event.

methods.name: AsyncWaitableEvent::setFuture
methods.description: Sets the future associated with the event.

methods.name: AsyncWaitableEvent::wait
methods.description: Waits for the future to complete, using condition variable.

methods.name: AsyncWaitableEvent::isReady
methods.description: Checks if the future is ready.

methods.name: AsyncWorkerPool::postWorkerTask
methods.description: Adds a task to the queue and initiates execution.

methods.name: AsyncWorkerPool::setMaxThreads
methods.description: Sets maximum number of worker threads.

methods.name: AsyncWorkerPool::checkToRunPendingTasks
methods.description: Starts pending tasks if thread limit not reached.

methods.name: WorkerThreadPool::Create
methods.description: Factory method to create a thread pool, either async or single-threaded based on configuration.

methods.name: WorkerThreadPool::PostWorkerTask
methods.description: Posts a task to the specified thread pool.
